name: Atlas
tagline: A personal knowledge base of references to look things up in: short facts, each linked to its official source.

families.label: IaC
families.description: Infrastructure defined in code: Terraform, its Azure provider and GitOps.

families.label: CI/CD
families.description: Pipelines that build, test and release software.

families.label: Development
families.description: Designing and securing applications: architecture patterns and certificates.

families.label: Enterprise
families.description: Identity providers and how large organizations are structured.

families.label: Test
families.description: Kinds of tests and how to run them: the test pyramid, for Python applications and for Terraform.

families.label: SaaS
families.description: Hosted platforms and services you build on: WorkOS and Cloudflare.

stages.label: Plan
stages.about: Decide what to build: requirements, backlog, design.

stages.label: Code
stages.about: Write and review source code and infrastructure code.

stages.label: Build
stages.about: Compile, package and store the artifacts.

stages.label: Test
stages.about: Automated tests, scans and quality gates.

stages.label: Operate
stages.about: Run, scale, configure and secure what is deployed.

stages.label: Monitor
stages.about: Metrics, logs and alerts, and the feedback into planning.

views.label: DevOps loop
views.description: The eight DevOps stages as an infinity loop, and the topics that belong to each stage.

views.label: Lenses
views.description: Where does a service go? One picture of an application, five lenses, a stack filter and the organization level.

topics.label: Test types
topics.description: The test pyramid: unit, contract, integration and end-to-end tests, and the other kinds around it, with an example for a Python application and for Terraform.

topics.label: Azure DevOps
topics.description: Azure DevOps services and the YAML pipeline reference: Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans, Artifacts, with every pipeline keyword.

topics.label: GitHub Actions
topics.description: Every workflow key, triggers, expressions and contexts, reuse, runners, security, limits and the gh CLI.

topics.label: GitLab CI/CD
topics.description: Pipelines, runners, templates and environments in GitLab.

topics.label: Jenkins
topics.description: Pipelines as code, agents, plugins and operating a Jenkins controller.

topics.label: Nexus Repository
topics.description: Artifact and package repositories: formats, proxying, cleanup and promotion.

topics.label: JFrog Xray
topics.description: Scanning artifacts and builds for vulnerabilities and licence issues.

topics.label: SonarQube
topics.description: Static analysis of code: quality gates, rules and pipeline integration.

topics.label: Azure with Terraform
topics.description: What an Azure service provides, what it needs, what it costs and how to build it with Terraform.

topics.label: Terraform
topics.description: The Terraform CLI on its own: the core workflow, useful commands, the configuration language, state, providers and modules, testing and debugging.

topics.label: GitOps
topics.description: GitOps principles, Argo CD in depth, Flux and other operators, and Helm, Kustomize and their alternatives.

topics.label: Architecture and design patterns
topics.description: How software is split by structure and responsibility: layered, MVC, hexagonal, microservices, event-driven, resilience patterns and the classic design patterns.

topics.label: Certificates
topics.description: X.509 and TLS basics, ACME and Let's Encrypt, private CAs, cert-manager and Kubernetes, and OpenSSL commands to inspect and troubleshoot.

topics.label: Identity providers
topics.description: Single sign-on and the protocols behind it (OIDC, SAML, LDAP, Kerberos, SCIM), open source identity providers, and how Argo CD and Kubernetes use one.

topics.label: Enterprise topologies
topics.description: How systems talk to each other: hub-and-spoke, mesh, tree, bus and ring, where each shows up in networks, services, messaging and data, and the products that implement them.

topics.label: WorkOS
topics.description: Enterprise-ready auth for apps: SSO, Directory Sync, AuthKit, RBAC and audit logs, from the WorkOS documentation.

topics.label: Cloudflare
topics.description: Workers, Pages, DNS, CDN, Zero Trust and the other Cloudflare products, from the Cloudflare documentation.
